modules.title: Carry-on
modules.lede: Aeroflot's official packing guidance gives the following cabin-bag limits. Check your cabin's allowance before travel.

standard_cabin_bag.value: One cabin bag up to 10 kg, measuring no more than 55 x 40 x 25 cm.

additional_bag.value: The same guidance permits an additional bag or backpack up to 5 kg, with combined dimensions no more than 80 cm.

modules.title: Checked baggage
modules.lede: Do not assume every Economy ticket includes a suitcase.

fare_specific_allowance.value: Aeroflot directs passengers to the checked-baggage allowance for their selected fare. Confirm the piece count and weight on your ticket before adding a bag.

modules.title: What the cheapest fare includes
modules.lede: Compare the fare conditions as well as the headline price, especially if you need checked luggage.

fare_and_baggage.value: The checked-baggage entitlement follows the selected fare; the cabin-bag allowance is a separate limit.

modules.title: If your flight is delayed or cancelled
modules.lede: Use the airline's current disruption notice and booking record to find the arrangements for your flight.

flight_updates.value: Aeroflot sends schedule updates using the booking's contact details and asks passengers to check the flight board and Manage Booking before leaving for the airport.

cancelled_flight_next_step.value: Its current disruption notice directs passengers with cancelled flights to the airline's rebooking and refund instructions and advises them not to travel to the airport.

airport_assistance.value: Aeroflot says assistance is provided under Russian Federal Aviation Rules. Ask the airline which services apply to your wait; this does not establish a universal cash-compensation entitlement.

modules.title: Check-in and airport cutoffs
modules.lede: Check in ahead of travel, then confirm your airport's counter, bag-drop and gate deadlines. Those closing times are not independently confirmed here.

online_checkin_opens.value: Aeroflot's official notice states that online check-in opens 24 hours before departure.

modules.title: Contact and the small print
modules.lede: Aeroflot's main site restricted access during this review. The guidance above is sourced from its verified official channel; exact fare and airport exceptions still need checking in your booking.
